name: jev
description: Adds $.jev: typed Choice, Score and Noul judgments from TypeSafe's Jev, with a timeout and validated answers, for other mods to call.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Sent only to api.typesafe.ai. Empty: TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

model.title: Model
model.description: Jev model id. Empty: TYPESAFE_MODEL from the environment, else jev-latest.
